votes.motion: A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robinson to approve Resolution #22-26c, a resolution approving the 2022 Annual Action Plan for the use of CDBG funds during the 2022 program year and authorizing the Mayor to submit the 2022 Annual Action Plan to HUD and execute associated documents
A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham, to approve the Consent Calendar
A motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded Zach Robinson to call to question, ending the discussion on the motion
A motion was made by Alison Stroud, seconded by Zach Robinson to table Ordinance #22-03 (Agenda Item 11) and bring the item back for Council consideration at the next Business Session (June 7, 2022)
A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robinson to table Ordinance #22-05
A motion was made by Zach Robinson seconded by Scott Earl, to convene a City Council Meeting on May 31, 2022 to discuss the Alta Canyon Recreation Center and the Special Service District

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Alison Stroud, to adopt Resolution 22-28C, a resolution consenting to the appointment of Kasey Dunlavy as Economic Development/RDA Director of Sandy City effective immediately
A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robinson to adjourn the City Council meeting at 10:25 pm and convene a meeting of the Redevelopment Agency
